title: [nightly/library] pip-audit: fail CI on known vulnerabilities in requirements.txt, and fix the ones with a safe bump
summary: pip-audit found 16 vulnerable pins (99 advisories), three on the scorecard upload path. This bumps 14 of them, adds a CI check that fails on any unlisted advisory, lists the 5 that need major upgrades with reasons, and limits uploads to the JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIF decoders.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/library-feature.
Frontend has a critical Capacitor advisory (fixed in 8.3.5) not covered here.
reviewFirst: UPLOAD_IMAGE_DECODERS: a TIFF named .jpg is now refused before decoding.
A new advisory turns every PR red until it's bumped or listed.
next: Frontend: Capacitor 8.3.5 and an npm audit check.
